notes.title: V1.4.0 & V1.5.0 - Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Imagine Island is back to its evergreen glory! Here's what we've updated:  


[b]New Costumes![/b]
[list]
[*] Dress to impress with a bunch of fresh outfits!  
[*] Winter Clothing and Sportsball Gear have arrived in the shop—grab them before they’re gone!  
[/list]

[b]Improvements and Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated FTUE: A smoother, more magical first-time experience awaits new explorers.  
[*] New Art: The Main Street and Castle Grounds have been refreshed with vibrant new designs!  
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Tricky Tower: Balanced for a fairer (but still tricky!) challenge. 
[*] Fewer suspicious snowmen and nutcrackers in tag!
[*] Coin Collection Audio: The hunt just got more satisfying with updated sound effects.  
[*] Performance Improvements & Collision Fixes: Your adventures are now faster and smoother!  
[/list]


That’s it for now—short and sweet! We can’t wait to see you sporting your new looks, tackling Tricky Tower, and enjoying everything the Island has to offer! 

Thank you for celebrating Wintermas with us! We hope you had a blast exploring the snowy island, decorating the tree, and enjoying all the festive fun.

Here’s to an amazing new year filled with even more magical adventures.

See you on the island!

notes.title: V1.3.0 - The Wintermas update is now available! ☃️❄️
notes.notes:
Snow is falling - Wintermas is here! ❄️✨ Get ready to feel the magic of the season with these frosty new features. Here’s what’s new:


🏀 Sportsball Minigame: The game is on! Grab your friends and get ready to score your way to victory in this all-new minigame!

🏰 Castle Grounds: A new area awaits! Complete a special quest to unlock this mysterious new area. What secrets will you uncover?

🎄 Wintermas Decorations: The island is sparkling with holiday cheer! Main Street and the Castle Grounds are ready for some festive flair, and you can help decorate!

🌱 Wintermas Tree: A little tree with big potential! Water it daily to help it grow into something truly magical.

☃️ Wintermas Catalog: Winter fashion is here! Bundle up in cozy Wintermas outfits, including the cheeky (and chilly) snowman costume.

🪄 MagiTool: What is this mysterious new item? Complete the quest to find out and unlock its power!

🪙 Daily Coin Hunt: Earn coins from a mysterious voice in a well. What does it mean? Who cares—free coins!

🎶 New Dance: Hit the dance floor with style! Use the music note emote to show off your new moves.

🏢 Tricky Tower Update: Less tricky, still a tower!


To learn more, read the full patch notes [url=https://imagineisland.game/blog/2024/12/11/v1-3-0-the-wintermas-update-is-now-available/]here[/url]!

The event will run from December 11th-January 6th, so bundle up, grab some hot cocoa, and dive into the Wintermas wonderland on Imagine Island! ❄️

notes.title: V1.2.0 - The November update is now available!
notes.notes:
The leaves are falling, and so are the new updates! 🍂 We've cozied up the island some festive fun, just in time for Thanksgiving! Here’s what’s new:

[b]In-World Updates[/b]

🦃  Thanksgiving Decorations: The Coffee Shop is looking extra cozy with festive Thanksgiving decor—stop by and check it out!

🍁  Fall Fashion: New fall outfits and accessories are here! Dress your avatar in seasonal styles, including sweaters, scarves, and cozy hats.

🌭  Hotdog Costume: Want to relish in some fun? Grab the new Hotdog Costume and make your avatar the life of the picnic!

🔧  Tricky Tower Update: We’ve made climbing Tricky Tower a bit easier, so you can reach the top without pulling out your hair!

📉  Lower Prices in the Mobile Shop: Leaves aren’t the only things falling! We’ve lowered the price of all items in the Mobile Shop, making it easier than ever to get the gear you love.

🐞  Bug Fixes & Performance: A few pesky bugs have been squashed, and we’ve polished up performance for a smoother adventure.


Bundle up, sip on a warm drink, and enjoy the fall vibes on Imagine Island! 🍂

notes.title: 🎃 The Halloween Party is Now Live! 🎃
notes.notes:
Hello Imaginators!

The wait is over—our Halloween Party is officially live! 🎉 The island has transformed into a spooky, fun-filled paradise, and we’ve packed it full of Halloween activities and surprises just for you.


Here’s what’s in store:

👻 Haunted Quest: Go for a wander down Wilderness Walk... You might find someone that needs your help!

🎃 Pumpkin Prop Hunt: Dive into our Halloween Prop Hunt with pumpkins galore! Plus, you can now earn Coins just for playing!

🕸️ New Costumes and Halloween Items: Dress your avatar in awesome limited-time costumes from the Mobile Shop. Don't miss out on these exclusive items!

🎶 Halloween Music & Decorations: Immerse yourself in the festive vibes with spooky tunes and creepy-cool decorations all over Main Street.


The event runs until November 1st, so make sure you jump in and experience all the fun before it’s gone!


See you on the Island!

notes.title: V1.1.0 - Halloween Party - is now available!
notes.notes:
The air is getting crisp, the pumpkins are glowing, and Imagine Island is about to get a whole lot spookier! We’ve been hard at work brewing up some exciting new content just in time for Halloween, and we can’t wait for you to experience it. From haunted quests to spooky costumes and festive decorations - and even some tweaks to your favorite activities! - this patch is packed with all sorts of treats (and maybe a few tricks). Whether you're here for the thrills, the costumes, or just some good old-fashioned duck hunting, there’s something for everyone in this update!

Check out all the details below and get ready for a hauntingly good time on Imagine Island!🎃


[b]In-World Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] General Spookiness: We've cranked up the spooky factor to near max! Main Street is looking appropriately spooky, with fun new Halloween decorations and ambient effects.
[*] Prop Hunt: Pumpkins are now the stars of Prop Hunt! There’s one big difference between the normal pumpkins and the prop hunt ones… Can you figure it out? Plus, you’ll now earn Coins for participating!
[*] Duck Hunt Update: The ducks have flown to five new secret locations. Can you find them all and claim ultimate bragging rights?
[*] New Theater: The Playground Builder has been swapped out for a brand-new Movie Theater, complete with a projector and blankets to sit on!
[*] Quackula Movie: Quackula is now live in theaters! Grab your popcorn and enjoy the spooky fun, there’s a showing every 15 minutes!
[*] Popcorn: Available now at the theater—grab it while stocks last!
[*] Halloween Music: Main Street now features eerie Halloween tunes to set the mood.
[*] Minigame Signs: Added signs to help you find the Ghostly Gathering and Tricky Tower minigames.
[*] Train Station Benches: You can now sit and relax on the train station benches.
[/list]

[b]Ghostly Gathering Minigame[/b]
[list]
[*] Matchmaking Update: Reduced the minimum player requirement from 4 to 2 to improve matchmaking in low-population times.
[*] Ghost Visuals: Updated ghost visuals to make them spookier!
[/list]

[b]HUD Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Sit Emote: You can now sit and relax with the new sit emote!
[*] Halloween Canned Chat: Added new themed canned chat options just in time for Halloween.
[/list]

[b]Mobile Shop[/b]
[list]
[*] Halloween Items: Get your hands on limited-time Halloween items before they’re gone!
[*] Costume Price Changes: We’ve reduced the cost of Character Creator items, including the fan-favorite Shark Outfit!
[/list]

[b]Quests[/b]
[list]
[*] New Max Welcome Message: Max has a fresh welcome message just for Halloween!
[*] Halloween Quest: A new Halloween-themed quest has been added! If you wander down Wilderness Walk, maybe you’ll find someone that needs your help…
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Tricky Tower Minigame Fixes: Fixed platform issues on lower quality settings to ensure all players can enjoy the climb.
[*] Collision Fixes: Fixed some collision issues near the waterfall.
[*] Improvements Performance and Controls: Miscellaneous fixes to improve performance and controls in-game. 
[*] Tag Fix: Users that are not participating in tag no longer see the results screen
[/list]

Enjoy the haunting new changes, and we’ll see you on the Island for some spooky fun! 🎃
